translations.web: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”
translations.bsb: Next Jesse presented Shammah, but Samuel said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”
translations.kjv: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.
translations.asv: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath Jehovah chosen this.
